fields.daysHint: 1 to 90. Counted from today, or from the current trial end if that is later.
fields.monthsHint: 1 to 12. The company becomes active from now for this period, without payment.
fields.limitsHint: Overrides apply on top of the plan. 0 to 1000. Existing members are not removed when a limit is lowered.

plan.title: Change plan
plan.description: Moves {{company}} to another plan. The plan limits and price change at once; the status and dates change only as you choose below.

trial.title: Extend or set the trial
trial.description: Changes the trial end of {{company}}. If the trial had expired, the workspace is unlocked again.

grant.title: Grant a free period
grant.description: Makes {{company}} active without payment from now for the chosen number of months. This replaces the manual SQL we used before.

limits.title: Edit limit overrides
limits.description: Sets individual admin and technician limits for {{company}} that replace the plan limits.

suspend.title: Suspend company
suspend.description: {{company}} becomes read-only for admins and technicians right away. Data is kept and the company can be unsuspended later.

unsuspend.title: Unsuspend company
unsuspend.description: Restores the status {{company}} had before it was suspended (trial or active). Access is unlocked again unless the trial has expired.

cancel.title: Cancel subscription
cancel.description: Sets the subscription of {{company}} to canceled: the workspace becomes read-only. Use Change plan to reactivate it later.

userDisable.title: Disable {{user}}
userDisable.description: {{user}} can no longer sign in and active sessions stop working. The account and its data are kept.

userRemove.title: Remove {{user}}
userRemove.description: Removes {{user}} from {{company}}. The account itself is not deleted and stays in any other company.

userRole.title: Change role of {{user}}
userRole.description: Changes the role of {{user}} in {{company}}. The plan limits for admins and technicians are checked.
